output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;
output.explanation: Gross margin percent per product category for 2025, using only completed orders (is_revenue = true). Margin is line net_amount minus cogs, summed per category and divided by summed net_amount, following the definition gross margin % = sum(gross_margin) / sum(net_revenue). Lines are joined to fct_orders for status and order date, and to dim_products for category. Orders are filtered to order_date in calendar 2025, which equals fiscal 2025.
